name_zh: 牙买加·鲍勃·马利：雷鬼拉斯塔与非洲团结政治癌症救赎
name_en: Jamaica Bob Marley: Reggae Rastafari & African Unity Politics Cancer Redemption
description_zh: 鲍勃·马利 (1945-1981) 雷鬼音乐之王，拉斯塔法里运动传播者，1978年一爱音乐会调解牙买加政治暴力，黑色素瘤癌症逝世，遗作《救赎之歌》成为全球自由颂歌。
description_en: Bob Marley (1945-1981) Reggae king, Rastafari movement spreader, 1978 One Love Peace Concert mediated Jamaican political violence, melanoma cancer death, legacy Redemption Song became global freedom anthem.
reason_zh: 马利代表音乐如何超越娱乐成为政治调解与精神救赎工具，展示了拉斯塔法里非洲回归主义如何通过雷鬼节奏触达全球边缘群体，其癌症逝世与救赎之歌形成生死超越的艺术闭环。
reason_en: Marley represents how music transcends entertainment becoming political mediation and spiritual redemption tool, demonstrating how Rastafari African returnism through reggae rhythm reaches global marginalized groups, his cancer death and Redemption Song forming life-death transcendence artistic closure.
steps_zh: 研究马利早年特伦奇顿贫民窟与韦尔斯乐队
分析雷鬼音乐传播拉斯塔法里非洲团结理念
探讨1978年一爱音乐会调解曼利/西加政治暴力
评估黑色素瘤癌症与救赎之歌生死超越
总结雷鬼拉斯塔非洲团结政治癌症救赎对全球边缘群体的精神解放
steps_en: Study Marley early Trenchtown slum and Wailers band
Analyze Reggae music spreading Rastafari African unity ideals
Explore 1978 One Love Peace Concert mediating Manley/Seaga political violence
Evaluate melanoma cancer and Redemption Song life-death transcendence
Summarize reggae Rastafari African unity politics cancer redemption spiritual liberation for global marginalized
expected_zh: 掌握音乐如何成为政治调解与精神救赎双重媒介，理解拉斯塔法里身份如何在癌症死亡面前实现生死超越，评估马利遗产对全球反抗音乐与非洲侨民认同的永恒激励。
expected_en: Master how music becomes political mediation and spiritual redemption dual medium, grasp how Rastafari identity achieves life-death transcendence facing cancer death, evaluate Marley legacy eternal inspiration for global resistance music and African diaspora identity.
case_zh: 1945 出生；1978 一爱音乐会；1981 癌症逝世。雷鬼拉斯塔非洲团结癌症救赎范式永存。
case_en: 1945 birth; 1978 One Love; 1981 cancer death. Reggae Rastafari African unity cancer redemption paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Reggae; Rastafari; political mediation; cancer redemption; African unity
artistic_legacy: 是: 雷鬼音乐/拉斯塔法里
